scope: Published company benchmark, reduced name/city/country view; not legal-entity/CRM production certification or comparable to full-attribute paper rankings

data_rules.missing_endpoints: quarantine pair; do not infer identity from URL
data_rules.contradictory_positive_closure: quarantine entire conflicting positive component and every incident label/record before split
data_rules.test_priority: keep valid original test labels; purge train/validation pairs touching any known-positive component of test endpoints
data_rules.validation_priority: then purge training labels touching retained validation components
data_rules.remaining_unlabelled_components: stable component-hash seed20260915, 60/20/20; never infer negative labels
data_rules.duplicate_pairs: collapse same-label same-split duplicates; test then validation wins across splits; conflicting labels quarantine
data_rules.gold_status: partial explicit labels only; no exhaustive cluster truth

normalization: existing NFKC uppercase punctuation removal, no learned country aliases

candidate_settings.soft_country: copy records with country=None ONLY for retrieval; score original fields; no service default change

primary_comparison.methods: mean of all three Ditto seeds vs fixed supervised_logistic
primary_comparison.metric: known positive pairs at review budget100

secondary_metrics: candidate known-positive recall and candidate count

thresholds.f1: maximum validation F1, conservative threshold ties

uncertainty.unit: components of known-positive relations and all retained test label edges
uncertainty.refuse_if: fewer than2 groups or largest group>50%
uncertainty.interpretation: conditional on fitted pipelines; neither training uncertainty nor population representativeness certified

neural.base_model: existing pinned roberta-base safetensors; no product-finetuned weights
neural.device: cuda only after shared GPU slot confirmation

adoption: research-only; no automatic merge/model deployment. Report positive/null/negative outcomes; accuracy claims require matching scope. No production cost threshold supplied
test_access: Structural preflight may inspect label relationships and schemas. Learners read held-out features only after all model bundles and validation thresholds are frozen. No tuning after results
stop_rules: GPU unavailable: complete CPU tracks and document neural status
At most three neural runs; no test-driven retries
old_evidence: WDC/Fodors/DBLP/registry reports retained unchanged; this is a new external benchmark study
